gripOrHq.title: Valu-Pak Software Bundle
gripOrHq.rulesText: Gain up to five consecutive actions, which you may use only to install programs, and gain [1]. If you do not spend the bit during these actions, return it to the bank afterwards.

gripOrHq.title: Armored Fridge
gripOrHq.rulesText:
Put seven Ablative counters on Armored Fridge when it is installed. When the last Ablative counter has been removed, trash Armored Fridge.
Ablative counter: Prevent 1 meat damage.

gripOrHq.title: Broker
gripOrHq.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

gripOrHq.title: Armored Fridge
gripOrHq.rulesText:
Put seven Ablative counters on Armored Fridge when it is installed. When the last Ablative counter has been removed, trash Armored Fridge.
Ablative counter: Prevent 1 meat damage.

rig.title: Blink
rig.rulesText:
[0]: Roll a die. On a 4, 5, or 6, break ice subroutine; otherwise, suffer that much Net damage.
Use this ability only once on each subroutine during each encounter with a piece of ice.

ice.title: Jack Attack
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] For the remainder of the run, Runner cannot jack out.
[Subroutine] Trace 5 - If trace is successful, give Runner a tag.

root.title: Solo Squad
root.rulesText: A: Do 1 meat damage. Use this ability only if Runner is tagged.

root.title: City Surveillance
root.rulesText: For each card Runner draws, give Runner a tag unless Runner pays [1], in addition to any other costs, to avoid receiving that tag. You may rez City Surveillance just before the card is drawn.
